text:
lara: Heads-up — routing rule for tenant header seems to be skipping matches for some requests. Saw it in prod traces: trace=t-987, example request had x-tenant: acme but route didn't pick it up. Anyone seen this? :thinking:

sam: Which route id / can you paste the rule config and a raw request example?

lara: Paste below. Note we were using `X-Tenant` in the expr.
```
route_id: tenant-acme
match:
  path_prefix: /api
conditions:
  - expr: req.headers['X-Tenant'] == 'acme'
  - expr: route.priority >= 50
```
Sample curl: `curl -H "x-tenant: acme" -H "trace-id: t-987" https://gw/api/foo`

raj: Quick thought — the expression runtime was migrated last week to use a unified context object `request` (and header names are normalized to lowercase). That means `req.headers['X-Tenant']` will evaluate to undefined. Try `request.headers['x-tenant']` or the helper `header('x-tenant')`. Also the engine does case-sensitive lookups on the literal key you use. :eyes:

sam: Ohhh that would explain the intermittent matches (older routes still using `req`). Can you repro locally with the eval tool?

raj: Yup. Ran this locally:
```
# old expr (what lara had)
devctl routes eval --route tenant-acme --req '{"headers":{"x-tenant":"acme","trace-id":"t-987"}}' --expr "req.headers['X-Tenant']=='acme'"
# output:
expr_result: false
```
Then with the corrected expr:
```
devctl routes eval --route tenant-acme --req '{"headers":{"x-tenant":"acme","trace-id":"t-987"}}' --expr "request.headers['x-tenant']=='acme'"
# output:
expr_result: true
```

olivia: We should add a console lint that parses exprs when you save a route and warns if they reference deprecated bindings (req -> request). Also update the docs & add a small unit test that exercises header normalization. I'll add a quick ticket. :memo:

sam: I'll push a tiny backwards-compatible shim in the expr layer to alias `req` -> `request` and add a WARNING in decision logs for a week so teams can see old usage. Will also roll a hotfix to ensure header lookup lowercases keys.

deploy-bot: deploy start: expr-shim-2026-03-18 by sam

deploy-bot: deploy success: expr-shim-2026-03-18 — 1902468105 :party_parrot:

lara: Verified on a couple of failing traces — rule matched after deploy. Thanks all. We'll follow up with the console lint. :thumbsup:
